backgrounds.name: Lamplighter
backgrounds.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Lantern, Oil (2 flasks), Tinker's Tools, Traveler's Clothes, 12 GP; or (B) 50 GP
backgrounds.text: You kept a city's lamps burning through the long nights, and learned what moves in the dark between them.

backgrounds.name: Hearth Warden
backgrounds.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Cook's Utensils, Blanket, Traveler's Clothes, 14 GP; or (B) 50 GP
backgrounds.text: You tended the common hearth of a mountain hold, where every traveler was fed and every quarrel settled by the fire.
